rows.en: Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!
Damn, what a bunch! If we don't stop the enemy's momentum… there'll be no end to this!!

Revived monsters or not… they're quite something!

And besides… that Gigant thing is proving to be a decent fighting force too.

Heh heh heh… Doktor G! I won't believe it until I see it with my own eyes…

Have the Riders' corpses brought here!! Let us confirm with our own eyes how they died!
Hmm… That's a fine idea!
Very well… You there, bring the Riders' corpses!
We've brought the Riders' corpses! Eee!!
Good… Bring them here!
Kukuku… What idiotic faces will they have? Let's take a good long look!
What!? What is this? These are Destron Combatants!!
Takeshi Hongo… Kamen Rider 1!!
Hayato Ichimonji… Kamen Rider 2!!
Shiro Kazami… Rider Number 3, V… Threeee!!
Joji Yuki… Riderman!!
Kotaro Minami… Kamen Rider BLACK!!
Curse you, you bastards!!
Bah, damn it!! Don't let them leave alive!! Get them!!

Don't panic!!

I've set this underground secret base's self-destruct device! They can't escape… They'll be blown sky-high along with this base! Ha ha ha…

We'll evacuate this way… Come, hurry!
Grr… Just when it was getting good, and this is how it ends!!
Destron's underground secret base blew up!? Is everyone all right?
Destron's underground secret base blew up!? Is everyone all right?

Yeah… We're all right!

But this is serious… Destron didn't revive only Shocker and Gel-Shocker monsters!

Colonel Zol and Doctor Death… even Ambassador Hell and General Black have been revived by Destron!

They must be scheming some enormous plot!!

Yeah… We're all right!

But this is serious! Destron didn't revive only Shocker and Gel-Shocker monsters!

Colonel Zol and Doctor Death… even Ambassador Hell and General Black have been revived by Destron!

They must be scheming some enormous plot!!

Yeah… We're all right!

But this is serious! Destron didn't revive only Shocker and Gel-Shocker monsters!

Colonel Zol and Doctor Death, who seem to be commanders of Shocker and Gel-Shocker… even Ambassador Hell and General Black have been revived by Destron!

They must be scheming some enormous plot!!

Yeah… We're all right!

But this is serious! Destron didn't revive only Shocker and Gel-Shocker monsters!

Colonel Zol and Doctor Death, who seem to be commanders of Shocker and Gel-Shocker… even Ambassador Hell and General Black have been revived by Destron!

They must be scheming some enormous plot!!

…We're all right!

But this is serious! Destron didn't revive only Shocker and Gel-Shocker monsters!

Colonel Zol and Doctor Death, who seem to be commanders of Shocker and Gel-Shocker… even Ambassador Hell and General Black have been revived by Destron!

They must be scheming some enormous plot!!
What on earth are they scheming?
What on earth could they be scheming?
Damn… I can't lose… I can't lose in a place like this… Nngh…
Damn… I can't lose… I can't lose in a place like this… Nngh…

Ha ha ha… So you survived? Kotaro Minami… no, Kamen Rider BLACK!

But look at this!
Kotaro… Never mind me!
If you want Tobei Tachibana back, rip open your own belly and hand the King Stone over to me!

Before I send you to the next world, let me tell you! The next Creation King… has been decided: I, Birugenia!

With this Satan Saber, bestowed on me by Lord Creation King, I'll defeat you and Shadow Moon both, and build Gorgom's empire in this world!
Curse you, you coward…
Curse you… you coward…
How despicable…
How despicable…
Despicable to the core…
Despicable to the core…
What a monster…
What a monster…
What a despicable bastard…
What a despicable bastard…
Still not!? Is he still not reviving!?
Ugh…
What's wrong? Pull yourself together! Bishium!
The strength… is draining… from… my body…
Ah… The energy of the three stones, Heaven, Sea and Earth, is running out!
If the energy runs out, our lives end too… Why won't he revive? Why!?
Ugh…
Ahh… It hurts… I can't…

Kuh… Please… answer… us… Lord Creation King…

With the stones of Heaven, Sea and Earth… will Shadow Moon… really… revive?
…!? What is this rumbling?
Th-this rumbling…
Ahh…
Ugh…
Sh-Shadow Moon… my lord…

Whoa… The Satan Saber! Curse you, this is the Archpriests' doing!

Hm!? Damn! The hostage is gone!? But he can't have gotten far…
Taking a hostage is cowardly! I'll take Mr. Tachibana somewhere safe…
Mari, thank you!
All right, let's go!!
Damn… impudent fools! I'll send you to hell too!
Kamen Riders!! I'll withdraw for today! But don't think you've won!
Where are you!? Archpriests!!
Heh heh heh…

Shadow Moon!? You've finally been revived?

The Satan Saber!? That sword is mine! Give it back!
Heh heh heh… This sword was prepared for me. Take it if you can.

Don't mock me!

Even if Shadow Moon has been revived, the next Creation King is me! I won't let you have your way!

Waaaagh!!

Curse youuu… Shadow Moon!!
The difference in power is obvious… How unseemly, Birugenia!

Y-you bastard…

Was I… nothing but a pawn? Lord Creation Kiiing!!

In the end, for one without a King Stone, the seat of Creation King was an impossible dream.

But one of those King Stones is still held by the Kamen Rider.

Listen well, Three Archpriests… and you monsters sleeping beneath the earth! I have been revived to build the Gorgom Empire across the world.

From now on… I, Shadow Moon, hold all real power. Begin preparations for world conquest at once!

Kotaro Minami… no, Kamen Rider BLACK! I am Shadow Moon, the next Creation King.

Birugenia has perished… From today, I take command of Gorgom!
You've been revived? Nobuhiko…
Wake up! Gorgom is controlling you! Nobuhiko!!
Nobuhiko…? I've forgotten that name!

uncertain: U09543/U09545: ライダーの死体 rendered "the Riders' corpses" (plural; there are several Riders).
U09546: Destron Combatant's cry イ～ッ rendered "Eee!!".
U09552: ライダー3号 ブイッスリ～ッ rendered "Rider Number 3, V… Threeee!!".
U09561-U09565: variant speakers of the same report; "We're all right" (plural) chosen since the group is asked.
U09574-U09583: 卑劣 lines rendered with "coward"/"despicable" variants matching each source wording.
U09584/U09589: Shadow Moon referred to as "he".
U09599: 人質 (Tachibana) referred to as "he".
U09613: 仮面ライダー rendered "the Kamen Rider" (BLACK, who holds the other King Stone).
